title: Explainable Deep Learning for Malaria Parasite Detection and Species Differentiation in Thick Blood Smear Images: A Pilot Feasibility Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.31855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Species-level differentiation of Plasmodium falciparum (PF) and P. vivax (PV) determines treatment, yet deep learning detectors rarely test whether their explanations are reliable. In this pilot feasibility study of TRACE-Mal, a research prototype combining YOLOv8n-seg detection and a six-model soft-voting ensemble, we examined whether agreement among three post-hoc explanation methods (Grad-CAM, LIME and SHAP) is associated with the correctness of species calls. the study analysed 2,847 parasite crops from 250 thick smears within publicly available Lacuna Malaria Datasets. The model achieved an mAP50 score of 0.79 and the ensemble had a macro F1 of 0.84 (PF recall 0.86; PV recall 0.74). Unadjusted analyses of crops revealed that predictions explained by greather than or equal to 2 methods were more accurate (86.2% vs 78.9%; difference 7.3 percentage points; 95% CI 3.5-11.1) compared to those explained by less than 2 methods. translated_title: 面向厚血涂片图像中疟疾寄生虫检测与虫种鉴别的可解释深度学习：一项初步可行性研究
translated_abstract: 恶性疟原虫（PF）与间日疟原虫（PV）的虫种水平鉴别决定了治疗方案的选择，然而深度学习检测器很少检验其解释结果是否可靠。本研究是对TRACE-Mal的一项初步可行性研究，TRACE-Mal是一个结合YOLOv8n-seg检测与六模型软投票集成的研究原型，我们考察了三种事后解释方法（Grad-CAM、LIME和SHAP）之间的一致性是否与虫种判定的正确性相关。该研究分析了来自公开可用的Lacuna疟疾数据集中250张厚血涂片的2,847个寄生虫裁剪图像。该模型达到了0.79的mAP50分数，集成模型的宏F1为0.84（PF召回率0.86；PV召回率0.74）。对裁剪图像的未调整分析显示，由两种及以上方法解释的预测相比由少于两种方法解释的预测更为准确（86.2% vs 78.9%；差异7.3个百分点；95% CI 3.5–11.1）。
tldr: 该研究提出TRACE-Mal原型，将YOLOv8n-seg检测与六模型软投票集成相结合，并验证了Grad-CAM、LIME和SHAP三种可解释方法之间的一致性与疟原虫虫种判定的正确性显著相关，即被两种及以上方法共同解释的预测准确率更高。
en_tdlr: TRACE-Mal combines YOLOv8n-seg detection with a six-model soft-voting ensemble and demonstrates that agreement among three post-hoc explanation methods (Grad-CAM, LIME, SHAP) is associated with more accurate Plasmodium species classification in thick blood smear images.
